Name: Ningqi's Doll grotesque furniture
Author: ningqi3
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4] [font=Comic Sans MS][i]Push open the creaking door, step into the puppet theater filled with the smell of decay, dim light, mysterious threads looming. We were hidden behind a heavy curtain, on the console, with the tap of our fingertips, the silk strings pulled the doll to move mechanically. We reveled in the thrill of absolute control as the characters performed silent plays on stage, following our absurd scripts. Suddenly, a sharp crackle broke the silence, and the mirror in the corner of the stage burst without warning. The broken lenses scattered, reflecting not a doll, but a distorted, frightened look of us. The rift tore open our illusion of control, and fear flooded in. In this theater that seems to be dominated by us, who in the end is weaving this nightmare of truth and falsehood in the dark? Who is it, is the poor puppet that is controlled by invisible silk thread[/i][/font][/color]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff0000][size=4][u]This is a furniture with AT replacement texture, and its name is doll series furniture, in which some elements such as a doll table, an informant doll, a broken mirror, etc. can be used in both the mobile phone version and the pc version. If you can't find it, you can search the original name in cjb keyboard to find the corresponding furniture replacement, and you can also find the corresponding furniture replacement in Happy Furniture mod. The furniture inside is from Obi Island, and the painting time is not too long, and the picture is not very beautiful. I hope you will like it.[/u][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][/size][/font]
